text:
Thank you! I was just surprised cause I know some friends that got their visa renewal for one year without interview on the spot when they handed in their documents. And not only they didn't check our documents yesterday but on top they told us it's normal to have two meetings a year, one for the documents and one four months later for the interview, which is a bit annoying. 

When I did my first visa application, everything (documents and interview) was handled in one day and I received a visa for one year... but it was also misrad hapnim Herzliya and not Tel Aviv...
